summary: Backend-only verification of the new premium (custom) emoji feature. Ran full regression: 119/119 pass (102 pre-emoji baseline + 7 entity-builder tests already written by main agent + 10 new payload/env-override tests I authored). New file /app/backend/tests/test_custom_emoji_send.py covers: (a) send_message payload structure with premium_emojis=True attaches entities of type=custom_emoji with correct offsets/lengths/ids; (b) premium_emojis=False omits entities key entirely; (c) text with no known emoji does not produce an empty entities key; (d) send_photo JSON-stringifies caption_entities for the multipart body; (e) send_photo omits caption_entities when premium_emojis=False; (f) CUSTOM_EMOJI_MAP env-var override (valid JSON dict) is honoured via importlib.reload; (g) invalid JSON and non-dict JSON both fall back to DEFAULT_EMOJI_MAP; (h) signature defaults for premium_emojis are True on both send_message and send_photo, guaranteeing routes/data.py callers auto-upgrade; (i) grep-verified that routes/data.py never explicitly passes premium_emojis=False.
critical_code_review_comments: services/custom_emojis.py:build_entities — correct UTF-16 offset accounting via _utf16_len (BMP chars count 1, supplementary-plane emojis count 2). HTML tags are stripped via a simple regex before offset computation, matching Telegram's server-side rendering. Multi-codepoint sequences like ⚡️ (U+26A1 + U+FE0F) are matched before single ⚡ by sorting keys descending by length — correct.

services/custom_emojis.py:_load_map — env-var override validated: JSON dict → adopted (string-coerced), non-dict/invalid → warned and fallback to DEFAULT_EMOJI_MAP. Module is imported at process start; changes to CUSTOM_EMOJI_MAP require restart (documented behaviour, matches the review's expectation of importlib.reload for tests).

services/telegram.py:send_message — premium_emojis kwarg defaults True; entities only attached when build_entities() returns non-empty, preventing the payload from carrying an empty 'entities':[] which Telegram silently ignores but wastes bytes. Wrapped in try/except so any entity-build failure logs a warning without breaking OTP/hit-forward paths.

services/telegram.py:send_photo — same guard as send_message plus JSON-stringifies caption_entities because httpx multipart uploads cannot inline a list value (Telegram Bot API spec requires JSON-encoded string for entity arrays on multipart methods). Verified in test_send_photo_caption_entities_json_stringified.

routes/data.py — all four forwarding paths (user DM, admin log channel, owner DM mirror, PUBLIC_SHOWCASE_CHANNEL_ID) call send_message/send_photo with no explicit premium_emojis argument, so the True default cascades automatically — no route-level change required. Verified via test_data_route_uses_send_message_without_override.

Backwards compatibility: send_otp, send_welcome, and any other legacy caller of send_message inherits premium_emojis=True. The OTP body contains 🔐 which is not in DEFAULT_EMOJI_MAP, so no entity is emitted — no behavioural change for OTP delivery. Confirmed by inspection of send_otp source.
test_credentials: N/A for these tests — monkeypatched services.telegram._post so no bot token or chat_id is needed. Broader suite continues to use conftest.py admin/active/expired fixtures.
seed_data_creation: None. New tests are pure unit tests using monkeypatch (no DB writes, no network).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend suite runs in ~53s: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` — 119 tests, all passing. Custom-emoji coverage lives in two files: tests/test_custom_emojis.py (7 entity-builder tests by main agent) + tests/test_custom_emoji_send.py (10 payload + env-override + signature tests added this iteration). Env-override tests use importlib.reload on services.custom_emojis and restore the default map in a finally block — safe to run in any order. Note the pre-existing harmless ERROR in admin_by_id_user teardown from iteration 7/8 is still present (does not fail any test).
rca of the issue: N/A — new feature verification, no bugs found. All 11 review scenarios (entity building, HTML strip offsets, UTF-16 lengths, VS16 fallback, extra_entities pass-through, send_message payload entities, send_message no-entities when premium_emojis=False, send_photo caption_entities as JSON string, backend regression baseline, CUSTOM_EMOJI_MAP env override with fallback, route wiring signature check) verified passing.
